svg.title: Credit-reporting complaints are increasingly concentrated among the largest companies
svg.text: Credit-reporting complaints are increasingly concentrated among the largest companies
Share of monthly CFPB credit-reporting complaints received by the largest companies, January 2025 – October 2026 (exact counts)
These figures measure how concentrated CFPB complaints are among companies. They are NOT company market share or a measure of industry competition,
and complaint counts are not adjusted for company size. Largest company = the company with the most complaints in each month (it can differ by month).
HHI = 10,000 × the sum of every company's squared share of the month's complaints. Recent months may be revised by later CFPB updates.
Source: CFPB Consumer Complaint Database (credit reporting), exact monthly counts via Sentinel AI query Q2.2 (sql/02_company_benchmarking.sql). Data snapshot: November 12, 2026.
